opportunities.name: Ryanair one-way/return flight search with fare add-ons
opportunities.description: Search Ryanair flights by choosing origin and destination (country then city), departure and return dates, and passenger count, then pick outbound and return fares, optionally apply a promo code, and search again.
steps: Click the 'From' field and choose the origin (type the city or pick country, then city).
Click the 'To' field and choose the destination (country, then city).
Open the date calendar, choose the month, and click the departure day.
Choose the return day if needed, then set the passenger count.
Click 'Done' or 'Search' to run the flight search.
Click 'Select' for the outbound flight, then 'Select' for the return flight.
Optionally open the fare add-on ('more') section, click 'Apply promo code', type the code, and click 'Search' again.

instances.values: Origin Dublin; destination first set to Athens (Greece) then changed to Malta; departure 22 Apr, later re-searched with 5 May; passengers 2; outbound and return selected. The Athens start and the Malta change are interleaved with other tasks, so the segment boundaries are approximate.

Origin typed 'TEL AVIV', then origin picker changed to Dublin / Paris Beauvais; destination 'VENICE' resolved to Venice Treviso; departure day 26 (Apr), return 9 May, another day 16 chosen; passengers 2; Select twice; fare add-on '$49.50 more' clicked; promo code '1000001' applied; Search.

opportunities.name: Booking.com attraction search by destination and date
opportunities.description: Browse the Attractions section, pick a destination (a specific attraction or a region), choose a date in the calendar, run the search, and filter or sort the results.
steps: Click the 'Attractions' tab.
Optionally click a region category (e.g., 'Asia').
Type the attraction or destination name in the search box and click the matching suggestion.
Click 'Select your dates' and click the chosen date in the calendar.
Click 'Search'.
Open a result, or click 'See availability', then set sort or filter options such as 'Most popular' and 'Show more dates'.

instances.values: Destination 'Aquarium of Paris' (search typed and suggestion picked); date 5 May 2023; Search clicked; result opened.
Category 'Asia'; destination 'Kyoto'; date 25 May 2023; sort/filter 'Most popular'; 'See availability'; 'Show more dates'; then 'Next'.

opportunities.name: Restaurant waitlist ('Notify for' meal) on Resy
opportunities.description: Find a restaurant on Resy by name, cuisine, or location, open it, choose a date and party size, click 'Notify for' the desired meal, set a preferred time, and confirm the notification request.
steps: Type the restaurant name or cuisine in the search box and click the result heading.
Optionally choose a location from the location picker.
Choose the date in the calendar and set the party size in the 'Guests' select.
Click 'Notify for Dinner' or 'Notify for Lunch'.
If prompted, choose the 'Preferred end time' from the select.
Click 'Confirm'.

instances.values: Search 'thai'; restaurant 'Senyai Thai Kitchen'; Notify for Dinner; preferred end time 7:00 PM; Confirm.
Location 'Sydney'; search 'pasta' (restaurant not identified); date Fri Apr 21 (April 17 calendar button); guests 2; Notify for Lunch. The restaurant selection step is not visible in the trace.
Opened 'New Openings'; search 'high tide'; restaurant 'High Tide'; location 'Columbus, OH'. Partial: no Notify or Confirm recorded.

opportunities.name: Event ticket search by performer/category with date filter
opportunities.description: Search for an event or open a ticket category on a ticket site, narrow results by date (preset or calendar), and open the ticket listings.
steps: Click the category button (e.g., SPORTS) or type the performer in the search box and click the suggestion.
Click the league or event link (e.g., 'All MLB Tickets').
Open the date filter and choose a preset (e.g., 'All dates', 'This weekend') or click 'Next month' and then a day.
Click 'Apply' or the listing link, such as 'TICKETS'.

instances.values: ticketcenter: category SPORTS; 'All MLB Tickets'; date filter 'All dates' then 'This weekend'; 'TICKETS' clicked.
seatgeek: search 'Coldplay' (paragraph suggestion); 'Filter by Date'; 'Next month'; day 17; 'Apply'.

opportunities.name: Product search on a store and sort by price
opportunities.description: Search or browse a product category on an online store, then re-sort the results by price.
steps: Type the product query in the store search box and submit it, or click a category link such as 'Climb'.
Open the sort control and choose a price order ('Price Low To High' or 'Price High - Low').

instances.values: gamestop: search 'xbox 360 games'; sort 'Price Low To High'.
rei: category 'Climb' then 'Explore Climb' and 'Shop all climbing gear'; sort 'Price High - Low'.
